description: S04's swell / lit-web shimmer carries over (frame 0 = S04's last frame)
▶▶ engages: tape-transport clunk + a short overexposed kick of the highlights
fast-forward whir starts and keeps rising in pitch (Shepard-like riser) until ~f170
「滚到最后呢？」 condenses (soft breath)
star 1 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
star 2 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
star 3 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
star 4 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
star 5 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
star 6 burns out: soft warm pluck + a short exhale of air (its light shell leaves)
cascade of tiny ember plucks thickens (one per dying star, ~3 per frame at the peak f74–96), panned by screen x; a warm dusk pad swells as the light haze fills the voids
year exponent rolls to 10^11
year exponent rolls to 10^12
year exponent rolls to 10^13
six black holes form on the heaviest clusters: sub-bass swell under everything until ~f176
year exponent rolls to 10^14 — lands (heavier tick)
one of the very last stars goes out
one of the very last stars goes out
one of the very last stars goes out
one of the very last stars goes out
THE LAST STAR goes out (reticle blinks): a single high glassy tink, then the cascade stops
a black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
black hole evaporates: faint pin-prick pop (high, short)
a black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
the exponent whirrs 14 → 100 (accelerating mechanical spin, peak speed ~f152)
black hole evaporates: faint pin-prick pop (high, short)
a black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
black hole evaporates: faint pin-prick pop (high, short)
a black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
black hole evaporates: faint pin-prick pop (high, short)
a black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
black hole evaporates: faint pin-prick pop (high, short)
the LARGEST black hole shrinks and heats up: a rising crackle of quanta
the exponent lands on 10^100 (thunk), the numerals start losing contrast
THE IMAGE DIFFUSES: every tone of the score starts to random-walk (pitch scatter) and smear into pink noise
the largest black hole evaporates: pin-prick flash, the sub-bass cuts out, a faint wide wavefront rolls across the frame
「温度处处相同。」
histogram instrument appears: dry data ticks; its bars collapse into one needle by ~f240 (a narrowing filter sweep on the noise)
▶▶ loses its direction: the ff-whir wobbles, detunes and stops meaning anything
pink noise → white noise: no more pitch anywhere
loupe opens (glass tick); the magnified gas: a granular crackle whose density follows the collisions
collision crackle peaks (the stream thermalises f262–300); afterwards a steady, directionless crackle
the timecode dissolves into the noise (its whir is gone)
the S-gauge slams into its top stop and chatters (small metallic clack)
loupe shrinks to the point (soft reverse tick)
「热寂。」 appears: a low breath under the flat noise
NOISE-DEATH: the sound collapses into flat, featureless noise (no spectral shape) and fades with the word
TRUE SILENCE (the film's only one): digital zero / at most −40 dB room tone until the gold point
the GOLD POINT ignites: one warm, pure high sine (the first tone after the silence)
the point flickers back on (tiny glassy tick)
「但在滚落的路上——」 condenses in warm white: a low warm pad swells under the sine, rising toward S06's sun
the point flickers back on (tiny glassy tick)
the point flickers back on (tiny glassy tick)
the point flickers back on (tiny glassy tick)
last frame: grey + gold point; sine + pad continue into S06 (the point swells into the Sun)
